<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def tiles():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']==9:
            bb=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in bb); c0=min(p[1] for p in bb)
            out.append((r0,c0,n['color']))
    return sorted(out)
def capstate(fr):
    seg = fr.segmentation
    cells = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']<=16:
            bb = n['boundary']
            r0=min(p[0] for p in bb); r1=max(p[0] for p in bb)
            c0=min(p[1] for p in bb); c1=max(p[1] for p in bb)
            if c0>=17 and r0>=17 and r1<=22:
                cells[(r0,r1,c0,c1)] = n['color']
    return cells
seq = [{'action':'MOUSE','row':50,'col':30},
       {'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':25},
       {'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':35},
       {'action':'MOUSE','row':60,'col':30},
       'LEFT','LEFT','DOWN']
for s in seq:
    action([s])
    r = last_action_result
    if r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done') or r.get('game_over'):
        print('STOP', s, r); break
print('tiles:', tiles())
print('cap:', capstate(current_frame))
a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print('timer top:', next(r for r in range(64) if a[r][62]=='N'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
